newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Pol Pot accused of murdering defence chief - Cambodian PM.
newsitem.headline: Pol Pot accused of murdering defence chief - Cambodian PM.

text.p: Notorious Khmer Rouge leader Pol Pot killed his defence chief in a grisly attack after political rifts opened in the movement responsible for Cambodia's "killing fields," the country's first prime minister said on Friday.

"Mr. Pol Pot has accused (defence chief) Son Sen of being allied with Second Prime Minister Hun Sen, so on the 10th of June at 2 a.m., he killed Son Sen and 11 of his family members very brutally, very cruelly, by shooting them and running over the dead with a truck," co-Premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh told reporters.
Ranariddh said he had photographs of Son Sen's dead body and those of his family members but he did not say when he would reveal them.
"I have enough evidence with pictures to show the killing of Son Sen," the premier said.

Ranariddh did not say where or how he obtained the news and photographs. But one of his senior military commanders returned last night from a one-day trip to the northern Khmer Rouge stronghold of Anlong Veng where he was said to have met Khmer Rouge hardliners.
Talk of conflicts between Pol Pot, the Maoist chief of the reviled Khmer Rouge, and his senior aides Son Sen and Khieu Samphan have surfaced over the past few days.
